cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a wood-fired bakery — a brick oven glowing orange, wire racks of loaves, a flour-dusted counter and a stack of baskets
cuts.scene: she is the head baker of the shop proudly lifting a huge loaf on the peel
cuts.outfit: a baker look fitted to her body — a short flour-dusted apron over a fitted tank top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a red scarf knotted at her neck
